items.title: São Luís (MA) Supplies & equipment procurement · direct award (dispensa) · closes Nov 26 #44
items.en_title: São Luís (MA) Supplies & equipment procurement · direct award (dispensa) · closes Nov 26 #44
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in São Luís (MA) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through direct award (dispensa), with an estimated value of about R$ 65,148.01; proposals close Nov 26, 08:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.

items.title: Braço do Norte (SC) Supplies & equipment procurement · signed contract #AF388061
items.en_title: Braço do Norte (SC) Supplies & equipment procurement · signed contract #AF388061
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Braço do Norte (SC) has signed a contract for supplies, equipment or consumables, awarded to Dm Licita Comercio e Assessoria LTDA, with a contract value of about R$ 880; signed Nov 19, 2026, in force until Dec 7, 2026. It is a closed deal rather than an open tender; see the official PNCP contract page for the full text and performance details.
